SETCAT-016.note: Supported native providers are versioned custom HTTP destinations. Shared configuration retains scoped keyring references; SecretServiceCredentialStore owns credentials. Ordinary catalog viewing/validation is local. The destinations UI now offers explicit Test connection and Cancel test: owned preparation resolves only the selected destination ID scope, and a content-free HEAD probe disables redirects, cookie load/save and authentication reuse. Filename-dependent endpoints are refused; success explicitly means HEAD reachability, not upload authorization. Escape/Close/cancel and owner destruction retire pending work or abort the reply, with timeout and value-free stable diagnostics. DestinationConnectionTestTest uses an injected counting network manager to prove zero requests on load/view/validation, click-only HEAD with no body, scoped credentials, invalid endpoint/refusal, success/HTTP/network/redirect/unsupported failures, cancellation before preparation and during transfer, timeout, owner teardown and redaction. No OAuth provider/authorization flow is currently supported. Rationale: reference CustomUploaderEditorViewModel.TestUploaderAsync is preview-only; the requested explicit HEAD probe supplies connection reachability without publishing sample/capture content. Human credential/security review remains Required before release. Final consent review found that viewing previously used an interactive secret lookup. Viewing now calls metadata-only availability (SearchItems, no session, Unlock, Prompt or GetSecrets), and connection preparation uses lookupWithoutPrompt so a locked keyring fails without leaving an authorization prompt. The injected credential counter proves viewing performs zero secret reads and the probe uses only non-prompting scoped reads. SecretServiceCredentialStoreTest::availabilityAndProbeReadsNeverUnlockOrPrompt adds real transport evidence, but its private D-Bus test must pass outside the sandbox before promoting these security-sensitive rows. Keep partial pending that evidence and credential/security review.
